description: Flattens the project and returns a PNG preview image so the model can see the composition. Optionally saves it to a file. Clipping masks, adjustment layers and layer effects are not rendered; the response lists what was skipped.

maxSize.description: Longest side of the preview in pixels

outputPath.description: If given, also writes the preview (PNG or JPEG by extension) to this path

path.description: Path to the .comp project package (a directory ending in .comp)

name: render_preview
title: Render preview
